source='''def rotate_cw(grid):
    return [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]

def rotate_ccw(grid):
    return [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]

def rotate_180(grid):
    return [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]

    cw = rotate_cw(grid)

    half = rotate_180(grid)
    return [list(grid[r]) + cw[r] for r in range(len(grid))] + [ccw[r] + half[r] for r in range(len(grid))]
